value.name: Tranco
value.quote: To initiate our data collection process, we select the “Top 10K domains” from the Tranco list, which is a reliable source of Internet-wide domain information [14].

value.name: Feodo Blocklist
value.quote: In addition to the top 10K domains, we incorporate the Feodo Blocklist into our data collection [9]; a blocklist that contains IP addresses associated from five different botnet families.

value.name: Blocklists
value.quote: To expand our dataset, we also include unlabeled blocklists that contain potential malicious IP addresses (i.e., Blocklists.de [13], Ci-Badguys [17], SSLBL [10], and Darklist.de [18]). In the paper, the term Blocklists refers to these 4 unlabeled lists.
